raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Preserve event topics during replay so reconnecting subscribers can recover cached prefixes for the correct model.

## Modifications

The Rust subscriber accepts both replay formats; consumers that require the old frame count need updating.<html>

Event body, after removing the replay envelope | Frames
-- | --
live kv events publishing | [topic, sequence, payload]
old kv events replay | [sequence, payload]
replay after this PR | [topic, sequence, payload]


## Validation

21 publisher tests and 20 subscriber tests pass, with cache recovery verified on CoreWeave before sending another generation request.


cc @ShangmingCai @ishandhanani 
fixing a drift between the published events to the replayed events
